stem: How did mercantilist policies create tension between Great Britain and the colonies?

options.label: F
options.text: By introducing indentured servitude to the middle colonies

options.label: G
options.text: By requiring colonists to enlist in the military

options.label: H
options.text: By limiting the amount of farmland each colonist could have

options.label: J
options.text: By preventing colonists from trading with most other foreign countries
